spec_case: issue #403: a member-access chain past Circuitry's own recursion budget for this shape
description: A 700-link member-access chain fails cof itself before the document ever runs: path collection walks the whole parse tree once per '.' link with no recursion guard, raising a RecursionError. core/cel_eval.py::_compile catches it and raises the same one line every other CEL check error uses, framed with the failing effect's own path (issue #629) -- electricity matches the phase (rejected at compile time, the document never runs) and now this exact text too, well above both engines' limits for this shape (electricity's own accessor-nesting cap, and cof's own floor on 3.11, 614 links after this fix). Neither limit is anywhere near 700, so a few frames' change in either engine's own call depth can't move this case across it; the boundary itself is covered by tests/core/test_cel_eval.py's own chain-length sweep (590-700 on cof).
